resources.string: The target user\'s encrypted storage is locked. This backup belongs to a cloned/secondary user. Please switch to that user and unlock it with the lock-screen credential, then return to the main user and retry the restore.

The target user (%1$d) is locked. Its credential-encrypted storage is unavailable, so its app data cannot be backed up. Please switch to that user and unlock it with the lock-screen credential, then retry.
